common_os_alt_key: Name of the Alt key as printed on the keyboard, in prose ("hold Option"). Shortcuts use a placeholder, not this.
common_os_enter_key: Name of the confirm key as printed on the keyboard, in prose ("press Return"). Shortcuts use a placeholder, not this.
common_os_file_manager: The OS app that shows files and folders, mid-sentence: "Reveal in {@common_os_file_manager}".
common_os_menu_bar: Where the app's icon lives while it runs in the background: "Atlas stays in {@common_os_menu_bar}".
common_os_your_computer: The user's machine, as a possessive noun phrase mid-sentence: "Atlas runs on {@common_os_your_computer}".
